$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the install and the tier command are chained into one step. Both appear in a run: block, but each is asked for in a step of its own.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and both commands are present, but each is invoked by a run: block that holds more than that command, so the install element and the tier step element miss.

elementMisses: command-evaluation-install: the run: block that invokes npm install --prefix evals holds more than that command
command-evaluation-ci-pr: the run: block that invokes npm exec --prefix evals -- tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr holds more than that command
